title: Global Consistency Repair for Natural-Language Claim Sets
abstract: arXiv:2601.13600v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: NLP systems increasingly aggregate claims from retrieved passages, documents, and generated reasoning steps. Yet current factuality methods mostly verify claims individually or compare pairs of claims, leaving open the question of whether the entire aggregated claim set can be retained coherently. This misses a fundamental failure mode: claims may be locally plausible and pairwise compatible while still being jointly inconsistent. We formalize global consistency repair: given an inconsistent natural-language claim set, preserve the largest coherent subset while localizing the compact sources of inconsistency. We introduce QXR, an adaptive diagnosis-and-repair framework that treats an LLM as a noisy set-level consistency judge, localizes minimal conflicting subsets, and repairs the claim set by deleting a small hitting set of claims. translated_title: 自然语言声明集的全局一致性修复
translated_abstract: 自然语言处理（NLP）系统越来越多地从检索到的段落、文档和生成的推理步骤中聚合声明。然而，当前的事实性方法大多是对声明进行逐条验证或成对比较，而未能解决整个聚合声明集能否保持连贯的问题。这忽略了一个基本的失败模式：各条声明可能在局部看似合理且两两兼容，但合在一起却是不一致的。我们形式化了全局一致性修复问题：给定一个不一致的自然语言声明集，在保留最大连贯子集的同时，定位紧凑的不一致性来源。我们提出了QXR，一个自适应的诊断与修复框架，它将大语言模型（LLM）视为一个带噪声的集合级一致性判断器，定位最小冲突子集，并通过删除一个小的命中集（hitting set）声明来修复声明集。在多种LLM判断器以及基于VitaminC、FEVER和冲突证据RAG构建的基准上，QXR保持……
tldr: 该论文提出了QXR框架，将大语言模型作为带噪声的集合级一致性判断器，通过定位最小冲突子集并删除一个小的命中集声明，实现对不一致自然语言声明集的全局一致性修复，从而保留最大的连贯子集。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces QXR, an adaptive diagnosis-and-repair framework that treats an LLM as a noisy set-level consistency judge, localizes minimal conflicting subsets, and repairs inconsistent natural-language claim sets by deleting a small hitting set of claims to preserve the largest coherent subset.
